method: Two assisted normal-time continuations of a copy of the stopped blank profile, for diagnostic reach and existing replay invitations. First tour used expert steering; the replay used good steering. Each road opened from its ordinary card. Balances include the real rewards during these visits. No claim about chosen duration or enjoyment.
